collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — RELATIONSHIPS, SINGLEHOOD AND FAMILY (FAM2-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Couples of every kind, courting, quarrels, separations without blame, widowhood and second loves, happily single and childfree villagers, single parents, grandparents, siblings, chosen and extended families, and affection that isn't romantic. Nobody has to love, marry or have children, everyone may say no to affection, and a player's choice never obliges a villager to anything.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks an elder who shares a hut with several others (where the game can tell); a single popup, no choice)

collection.description: Around an elder's crowded fire sit everyone who lives in the hut, however they are connected, and it is a family.

setup.name: The scene
setup.text: It's dinnertime at (name1)'s hut, and everyone who lives there is crowded around the fire. There's (name1), who is older than anyone and still insists on stirring the pot. There's a grown child and their partner. There's a cousin who came to stay for a week three years ago and never quite left. There's a child who arrived two seasons back and is family now, whatever anyone says. There's a friend who isn't related to anybody but comes every night anyway. There's a dog, who isn't supposed to be inside. Nobody in the hut could draw exactly how they're all connected. Nobody's ever tried. The fish is a bit burnt. Someone's telling a story nobody believes. The child is falling asleep against the dog. (name1) looks around at all of them and thinks: this is a family. It isn't the shape anyone would have guessed. It's the shape it is, and it's exactly right.
